business_problem: Autodesk’s data engineering teams were discovering data issues too late because their custom quality system was passive, notifications were inconsistent, and ownership across a growing data mesh was unclear.
solution_summary: Autodesk implemented IBM watsonx.data integration (formerly Databand) as a proactive observability layer for its data platform so teams could detect, diagnose, and respond to pipeline issues before they impacted downstream users. The platform integrates with Autodesk’s modern stack—including Apache Airflow, dbt, Spark, and Snowflake—to watch more than 1,000 DAGs, detect workflow failures and schema changes, monitor data at rest, and run inline tests in real time. Instead of relying on after-the-fact emails or Slack messages, teams now receive immediate alerts and root-cause context that help them trace incidents back to source systems quickly. Because the implementation did not require rewriting core pipelines, Autodesk could extend observability across batch processing, customer-facing data products, and ML/AI pipelines without disrupting delivery. The result is a more resilient data-mesh operating model where detection time is near zero, MTTR is measured in days instead of weeks, and cloud costs fall because failed runs are caught early.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.data integration
solution_components.role: Monitors Autodesk’s pipelines and data quality in real time, delivering alerts, root-cause analysis, and observability across the modern data stack.

data_flow: Pipeline runs and data-quality checks from Airflow, dbt, Spark, and Snowflake feed into watsonx.data integration, which detects anomalies, sends immediate alerts, traces root causes back to source systems, and returns the resulting signal to data engineering teams before issues propagate into products or ML pipelines.
business_outcome: Autodesk shifted from reactive firefighting to proactive observability, cutting time-to-detect and time-to-resolve data issues sharply while also reducing cloud consumption wasted on reruns and bad pipeline execution.
